notes.title: Patch 0.4 | Hotfix 1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed bug causing irregular behavior in rotating camera.
[*] Fixed bug preventing cross guard to initialize as primary guard from southpaw stance.
[*] Fixed bug causing damage zone flashes from all fighters to trigger on right side overlay HUD.
[*] Addressed bug causing referee to get stuck on the ropes or exit the ring(rare occurrences are still possible).
[*] Removed penalties regarding downed fighter due to inconsistency. Will return once fixed.
[*] Added "active referee" toggle in bout settings.
[*] Shove defense disabled when Showboat Mode is active.
[*] In co-op Focus Mitts, trainer stance must correspond with trainee stance to request punches. Otherwise, trainer will be alerted by an overhead prompt to switch stances.
[*] Multiplayer setup menu icons default to the default controller type selected at startup.
[*] Old school rules count limit slider defaults to 30 seconds for historic accuracy.
[*] The corresponding button of your currently equipped shoe will be selected when opening the shoe selection screen.
[*] The corresponding button of your last selected shoe section will be highlighted when opening the section selection screen.
[*] Improved load player screen layout to visualize more buttons.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.4 | Active Referee + New Guards
notes.content:
[b]BUG FIXES[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed bug preventing zone health from regenerating when temporary value reaches 0.
[*] Fixed bug causing punch tracking to activate on wrong arm during a stance switch.
[*] Fixed bug preventing player from attacking shortly after a stance switch.
[*] Fixed bug causing players feet to get stuck in the Locker Room floor.
[*] Fixed bug causing AI to be less active in the Locker Room.
[*] Fixed bug preventing trainer damage animations to trigger in Focus Mitts mode.
[*] Fixed bug causing unofficial scorecard to display names of fighters from previous bout.
[*] Fixed bug causing dashes to reduce stamina twice.
[*] Fixed bug preventing fighters from facing each other at the beginning of fights.
[*] Fixed bug preventing knockdown animations to trigger when knocked down by doubled punches from the lead hand.
[*] Fixed bug causing cornermen counter punch reactions to interrupt each other.
[*] Fixed bug that caused a delay in the "ready up" function.
[/list]

[b]CORE UPDATES[/b]

[list]
[*] Olovmetal added to the contributors list in the Credits menu.
[*] Added old school rules option to Simulation Boxing.
[*] Added physical referee to Simulation Boxing.
[*] NEW Simulation Boxing penalty to deduct points if fighter takes too long to get away from downed fighter or returns to downed fighter during the count. 
[*] NEW co-op Focus Mitts game mode.
[*] Removed personal best Focus Mitts streak for individual save files.
[*] Added round break and trainer controller map to Controls menu.
[*] Added list of advanced combat controls to Controls menu.
[*] Added headgear toggle to fight settings(+15 to chin attribute).
[*] Added invert pivot toggle to player settings.
[*] Added counter clock toggle to HUD settings.
[*] Added zone damage toggle to HUD settings.
[*] Sparring mode is now multiplayer compatible.
[*] NEW Hand wraps added to player model.
[*] NEW customizable shoe options available for player model.
[*] NEW corner pad model added to boxing ring.
[*] Improved lighting in The Sweatbox(should reduce frame drops).
[/list]

[b]GAMEPLAY UPDATES[/b]

[list]
[*] Added ability to chose primary and secondary guard in Fight Style menu.
[*] Added cross guard and long guard.
[*] Added showboat mode(sacrifice blocking and vulnerability for stronger counter punches and a bigger counter radius for head movement).
[*] Pressure sensitive leveling added to pawing mechanic(activate by applying downward pressure to right joystick).
[*] Stance switch is more responsive.
[*] Players can do standing taunt when roaming input is active.
[*] Taunts are interrupted when damage is taken.
[*] Punch ability slightly delayed when taking counter punches.
[*] Focus Mitts trainer stance corresponds with your stance.
[*] Increased request/revoke speed of Focus Mitts trainer.
[/list]
 
[b]UI UPDATES[/b]

[list]
[*] Added flash animations to bout display to indicate penalty events.
[*] Added animation to referee count in Simulation Boxing.
[*] Added spreading flash animation to zone HUD for counters.
[*] Added new damage HUD icon model.
[*] Focus mitts timer replaced with fading button icons.
[*] Added colored spreading flash animation for button prompt confirmations in Focus Mitts and get up game in Simulation Boxing.
[*] Added new guard icon models to player indicator. When blocking attacks, the corresponding arm on the icon flashes. Spread flash occurs to indicate successful parry.
[*] Added controller type option to Controls menu with corresponding button prompt images.
[*] Winner has control of post-fight menu in Simulation Boxing; loser has control in Arcade.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.3 | Hotfix 2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Slightly reduced power threshold for flash knockouts
[*] Fixed bug preventing user from creating players from Edit Player menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.3 | Hotfix
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fail-safe installed to fix bug preventing user from loading pre-existing player files. All saved player files will be deleted on first startup.
[*] Fixed bug causing fighters to recover a 2nd time when standing from stool.
[*] Fixed bug preventing menu navigation on Fight Settings screen when selecting a party game.
[*] Fixed bug causing ropes to freak out when game paused 
[*] Fixed bug preventing AI from switching to roaming when getting up from a KO loss.
[*] Fixed bug causing fighter to focus on heavy bag when it's out of field of view.
[*] Fixed bug preventing AI to lower his guard when switching from defensive mode in sparring.
[*] Increase transition speed of combo "1H-2B"
[*] Increased transition speed of combos "3H-4B" and "3B-4B"
[*] Added head and body health meters to punch stats screen. 
[*] Health meters on punch stats screen pulse when low.
[*] Increased difficulty of get up game by lowering faculty reward cap from 0.075 to 0.01
[*] Reduced volume of bell in simulation mode.
[*] Slightly lowered AI chin and toughness attributes.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.3 | Simulation Boxing
notes.content:
[b]Bugs/ Performance Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug causing app to close on startup when using Steamdeck without internet connection.
[*] Fixed mass fluctuation issue that caused players to fly out of ring.
[*] Fixed bug causing random counters.
[*] Fixed bug causing lead foot to get stuck to opponent lead foot.
[/list]

[b]General Core Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] New venue with realistic base model boxing ring(fighter containment elements and environment layout still a work in progress).
[*] Improved ring canvas texture in Bonkers Gym.
[*] New rotating camera view in camera settings.
[*] New "Team Battle" game mode (2 vs 2).
[*] New "Simulation Boxing" game mode.
[*] Fight now mode changed to "Street Fight" and located in Main Menu>Game Modes>Arcade along with party games.
[/list]

[b]Menu/ UI Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Camera shake toggle added to camera settings tab.
[*] Counter flash toggle added to game settings tab.
[*] Toggles for stamina and health meters added to HUD settings.
[*] Controller vibrations toggle added to fight style/ player settings.
[*] Defensive arm position slider added to AI settings(sparring only).
[*] Auto-pivot toggle added to AI settings(sparring only)
[*] Head/ Body damage level options added to AI and player settings(sparring only).
[*] Improved aesthetic of zone damage HUD. Intensity of damage flashes are influenced by the power of landed punch.
[/list]

[b]Core Gameplay Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved counter punch detection with head movement.
[*] Counter punch damage reactions are more responsive.
[*] Pressure sensitivity added to arm stretch of pawing mechanic(RT/ R2).
[*] Increased feint recovery speed.
[*] Increased duck speed.
[*] Increased crouching movement speed.
[*] Increased punching power in bare knuckle game modes.
[*] No attack damage registered in sparring game mode.
[*] Fighters track enemy with their heads when enemy in field of view.
[*] Body target slightly lowered for improved body shot tracking.
[*] Audio/visual feedback added for touching gloves within the first 10 seconds of each round(ability will be revoked if a punch is thrown prior to touching gloves).
[/list]

[b]Stamina Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Stamina penalty added for push, paw, and parry attempts.
[*] Increased stamina penalty for dash, pivot, and stance switch.
[*] Reduced mobility penalty for low stamina.
[*] Reduced stamina penalty for body shots taken.
[*] Conditioning attribute added(determines stamina drained per action).
[/list]

[b]Blocking Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Blocking/ parry poses adjusted to better represent openings based on arm position.
[*] Blocking idle poses converted to pressure sensitive blend trees(LT/ L2)
[*] Blocking sound effects trigger only when block zones are hit.
[*] When taking damage to any damage zone, punch sound effect plays even if punch was blocked (volume of sound effects influenced by the power of landed punch).
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed bug causing player limbs to drift away from body while game is paused.
[*] Fixed bug preventing southpaw stance from loading at the start of gameplay.
[*] Fixed bug keeping user from taunting in southpaw stance.
[*] Fixed bug preventing punch sound effects to play when user is knocked out.
[*] Fixed bug causing parry inputs to be stored in memory and triggered when user resumes blocking.
[*] Fixed bug causing player to continue moving when left stick is in neutral position.
[*] Base movement speed slightly increased (from 1.35 to 1.5).
[*] Dash distance slightly decreased (reduces more with low stamina).
[*] Jab speed slightly increased.
[*] Addressed bug causing AI to randomly fly out of ring (could still occur but very seldom)
[*] Lowered muscle spring values of ragdolls in attempts to fix bug that causes players to fly out of ring (could still occur but very seldom)
[*] Rage meter toggle added to Fight Settings menu.
[*] Fight Settings menu added to Party Games.
[*] Knockouts can no longer be achieved with jabs.
[*] Prototype iteration of flexible ring ropes.

[*] Expansion of Settings menu (only Player 1 has access to the following settings via pause menu)
[list]
[*]Game settings panel (due to change)
[list]
[*] Slow motion toggle
[*] Motion blur toggle
[/list]
[*] Camera settings panel
[list]
[*] Camera zoom toggle
[*] Camera height dropdown
[/list]
[*] HUD settings panel 
[list]
[*] Player indicator toggle
[*] HUD Type dropdown (off, world space, or overlay)
[/list]
[*] Audio settings panel
[list]
[*] Music volume
[*] Pain sound effect toggle
[/list]
[/list]
[/list]

notes.content:

[*]Added advanced controls tutorial videos to pause menu for convenience
[*]Revised create player instructions for clarification in Edit Player scene and multiplayer setup menu
[*]Fixed issue that caused AI face to appear blacked out.
[/list]
